footnote_text: Represents a one-time award grant of time-based restricted stock units subject to all the terms and conditions of awards granted under the issuer's 2024 Performance Incentive Plan, as amended, as if it were made under such plan. Each time-based stock unit represents the contingent right to receive, upon vesting of the unit, one share of the issuer's common stock. One third of the units are scheduled to vest on each of the first, second, and third anniversaries of the date of grant. The closing price on date of grant, September 15, 2026 was $7.25. || Includes 11,160 shares subject to vesting and forfeiture restrictions.
